messages:
Olivia: hey @ravi @sam - marketing is finalizing the benchmark callouts for the launch post. we need eng/runtime to double-check aggregation method and warmup details before we publish. can you confirm how P50/P95 were computed and the warmup policy?

Sam: please paste the exact payloads, model tags, and run command used for the headline numbers so we can reproduce.

Olivia: used three seq buckets (short/med/long), both fp16 and int8 builds. samples: 
```
# short
{"input": "Summarize: The product helps devs ship LLM features."}
# med
{"input": "Explain how Redwood reduces inference cost and latency for production apps."}
# long
{"input": "Simulated long context ~1024 tokens."}
```
run: batch=8, concurrency=16, steady=30s after warmup, repeats=5. models: rdx-13b-v1, rdx-13b-v1-quant-int8. marketing note currently says "median of shard-level P50s."

Ravi: two options: (A) compute P50/P95 on pooled raw latencies across all shards (true user-level percentiles) or (B) compute P50 per shard then take median across shards (stable against noisy hosts). eng-runtime recommends pooled for accuracy but can provide both. for int8 we'll run 5+ repeats and capture p99.

Jordan: also add cold-starts (first N requests) and a streaming fallback simulation (1 token/sec) to catch buffer effects.

Mia: marketing needs per-token GPU/CPU utilization and mem headroom CSVs so we can build charts.

Olivia: include exact bench command in thread please.

Ravi: example command: `./bench_runner --model rdx-13b-v1 --quant int8 --batch 8 --concurrency 16 --steady 30 --repeat 5 --output /tmp/bench-2113` - will attach run_id, node list, seed. bench-bot: enqueueing job.

bench-bot: queued job 2113-rt-091 for rdx-13b-v1 (quant=int8).

Ravi: ETA ~24h for full sweep (fp16+int8, pooled+shard-median outputs, per-token traces). we'll tag runs with GPU mem spikes >90% and note retries/ooms separately.

Olivia: perfect. marketing will use pooled stats in the main post and include shard-median as appendix with methods. please post run_id and a short summary when done. :thumbsup:

Sam: also attach 10 sample prompts comparing outputs across variants for product/legal review.

Ravi: will attach raw logs, CSV parser, and sampled outputs. will update here with run_id and summary when finished.

Olivia: thanks everyone :pray:
